supervisor.origin: runOwned captures launch = readNow() before starting the child factory
supervisor.arming: active owner is installed, start event recorded, arm() schedules deadline timer, then start() calls real spawn
supervisor.success: Transport completion AND closed promise; final strict checkpoint; native console-quiescence predicate; helperUsedMs charged through that confirmed quiescence
supervisor.expiry: checkpoint observes now >= minimum applicable deadline, fixes original terminal error and terminalAt, rejects stopped promise; no later response restores success
supervisor.cleanup: Terminate/destroy streams; await closed only until terminalAt+2000; confirm both closed within allowance and native console quiescence; otherwise record false and abandon/unref without permitting next work

transport.preSupervisorWork: Request decoding and detached Buffer copy occur before runOwned; they remain under overall CLI admission and, in real CLI orchestration, the earlier sequence clock
transport.launch: Exact fixed PowerShell 5.1 executable/arguments, sanitized environment, hidden non-detached pipe process
transport.success: All process and three pipe close flags; stdout/stderr EOF and stdin finish; exit0; exact matching decoded frame; strict checkpoints; responseBytes returned only with exitConfirmed:true
transport.importantDistinction: A complete frame, child exit, child close, and exchange settlement are different observations. Valid frame supplies source-backed proof of prior native owned-console quiescence, not its exact timestamp.

sequence.source: Independent private sequence admission guard in the unchanged CLI
sequence.origin: begin() checkpoint sample at line200 is stored as state.launched at213; it includes subsequent request validation/encoding/roundtrip before transport launch
sequence.limits: Own5000ms per-slot and20000ms aggregate plus30s sequence clock; supervisor remains actual process preemption owner
sequence.completion: complete() validates response between deadline checkpoints; helperExited() performs another checkpoint then charges elapsed and clears launched only after trusted exit acknowledgment
sequence.scope: Transport timings cannot be relabeled as exact sequence durations. Sequence includes bounded trusted request/response framing around the supervisor lifecycle.

helper.initialization: Open redirected stdin/stdout, initialize fixed native signatures and confirm owned-console quiescence before reading request header
helper.response: Construct canonical response, write header/body, flush then exit0

strictness.canTimerFireEarly: Timer callback may be scheduled/observed later due to host scheduling; checkpoint itself refuses TIMEOUT unless now>=applicable limit. Source does not establish early timeout.
strictness.cleanupAfterDeadline: Failure settlement may occur after5000ms and is not success grace. Raw elapsed>=5000 cannot alone locate the exact terminal observation.
strictness.aggregateShortening: A helper can legitimately receive less than5000ms when remaining aggregate orCLI budget is smaller; record which deadline is limiting.

eventPlan.method: Record supervisor start.at and deadline separately. Real origin is runtime launch sample; for a fresh single-helper supervisor with per-helper limit controlling, launch=deadline−5000 is derived, not directly observed start.at.
Timestamp immediately after unchanged real spawn returns with child identity. This is Node spawn-return latency, not an independent kernel CreateProcess timestamp.
Node spawn event proves successful creation. Native retained handle/HasExited or wait state can prove a live process; neither establishes PowerShell engine readiness or continuous CPU execution.
No readiness signal exists in unchanged protocol. Stdin finish does not prove helper consumption. Do not infer an exact bootstrap endpoint.
stdin finish means request bytes accepted by writable pipe; supplied to transport, not proven consumed by helper.
First nonempty stdout data chunk timestamp.
Timestamp bytes reach advertised complete frame size; subsequently require exact complete frame/EOF and normal production validation.
Record Node child exit separately from close/all-pipe settlement; retained native process handle exit time where available gives additional observation.

Retain positively attributed conhost handle; native exit time/signaled observation if captured. If never captured mark NOT_OBSERVABLE. A valid response only establishes that native quiescence preceded it.

derivedLimits: T5−T4 andT6−T4 include any remaining PowerShell/bootstrap/native initialization, waiting and request work; they are not pure execution CPU time.
Bootstrap duration cannot be isolated from these timestamps without a trusted external observable boundary. CHECK_OUTPUT supplies only a comparative low-workload observation.
Console quiescence normally occurs during Initialize-Native before request consumption; T8 is not necessarily later thanT7. Retain actual signed ordering, never force an artificial final event.

earlyStop.reason: No explicit contract contradiction or deterministic early-timeout/cleanup defect established by source review; future measured evidence may activate user stop policy.
